visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with thinning hair, wearing a black suit and a patterned tie, stands behind a white-clothed round table outdoors. He is hunched over, writing on a piece of paper with a blue pen. Behind him is a tranquil sea and a grey sky. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the man's face and hands as he holds the handwritten letter, his expression solemn and focused. The background consists of green hedges and a stone wall. (3) Indoors, a young woman with dark hair in an elegant updo, wearing a white, sequined off-the-shoulder wedding dress and pearl jewelry, sits with a tearful, emotional expression. (4) The man is now indoors, standing at a podium decorated with red roses, holding a microphone in one hand and the letter in the other as he delivers a speech. (5) A series of black and white shots depict the man looking out a window and the bride walking through a grand hallway with ornate wooden paneling and a large framed painting. (6) The man and the bride are shown together; he turns to see her, looking surprised and joyful, and they share a warm embrace. (7) The duo is seen dancing in a grand ballroom featuring a massive wooden staircase, high ceilings, and warm, cinematic lighting. (8) The scene returns to the man concluding his speech at the podium. (9) A close-up shows the bride using a white cloth napkin to gently wipe tears from her eyes while sitting at a dining table with glassware.
